what: Bus-side CLAIM tasking proven cross-machine: a HOST coordinator dispatched a CLAIM to the VM WORKER, which claimed it (ACK), ran the provider delegation locally against the host Ollama over TCP, and returned the DONE receipt to the host observer -- all over bus-msg@1 / ADR-0003 framing.

topology.hostToWorker: NAT forward host 127.0.0.1:7440 -> guest :7440 (VBoxManage natpf1 uplift-worker)
topology.workerToHost: guest reaches host observer at 10.0.2.2:7420 (NAT gateway)
topology.provider: ollama llama3.1:8b on the host, reached from the VM at 10.0.2.2:11533 (TCP proxy)

flow: worker: CLAIMED uplift:doc-draft id=T-GATE-SUITE-NOTE -> reply 10.0.2.2:7420 (ACK to host observer)
worker: ran runDelegation against host Ollama over TCP; verdict=pass
worker: DONE id=T-GATE-SUITE-NOTE verdict=pass announced=true (DONE receipt to host observer)
deterministicProof: verify-claim-tasking.mjs -> PASS, 7 assertions (loopback, mock provider): dispatch -> worker ACK -> DONE receipt; verdict pass for a good task, fail for an unmeetable one.
note: Comms-only: only the CLAIM/ACK/DONE frames crossed the bus; the provider ran off the VM's network. Wire-compatible with lbabus net (a real lbabus could send the CLAIM or observe the DONE).
